newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Tasmania bowl Pakistan out for 299.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Tasmania bowl Pakistan out for 299.

text.p: Tasmania all-rounder Shaun Young took seven wickets as Pakistan were bowled out for 299 shortly after tea on the first day of their four-day match at Bellerive Oval on Thursday.
Young finished with seven for 64 from 18.3 overs after tearing through a weakened Pakistan batting line-up.
Pakistan's total would have been far smaller but for a seventh wicket partnership of 74 between Shahid Afridi and Mushtaq Ahmed.
Afridi, holder of the first-class record for the fastest century, top-scored for Pakistan with 80 before falling to Mark Hatton. Mushtaq hit 65 before he was dismissed by Young.

Pakistan went into the match without injured opener Aamir Sohail, who needed 10 stitches in a head wound after slipping in a dressing room mishap following his side's seven-wicket defeat by West Indies on Tuesday.
Spin bowler Saqlain Mushtaq opened the batting in Sohail's absence and became Young's first victim when he fell for 10.
Young then snared Ijaz Ahmed for a duck with his next ball but missed the chance of a hat trick.
Young also accounted for top order batsmen Inzamam-ul-Haq and Mohammad Wasim and wicketkeeper Moin Khan.
